1.web: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to put with my sheep dogs.
1.asv: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, Whose fathers I disdained to set with the dogs of my flock.

2.web: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?
2.asv: Yea, the strength of their hands, whereto should it profit me? Men in whom ripe age is perished.

3.web: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.
3.asv: They are gaunt with want and famine; They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of wasteness and desolation.

4.web: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom are their food.
4.asv: They pluck salt-wort by the bushes; And the roots of the broom are their food.

5.web: They are driven out from the midst of men. They cry after them as after a thief;
5.asv: They are driven forth from the midst of men; They cry after them as after a thief;

6.web: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
6.asv: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, In holes of the earth and of the rocks.

7.web: Among the bushes they bray; and under the nettles they are gathered together.
7.asv: Among the bushes they bray; Under the nettles they are gathered together.

8.web: They are children of fools, yes, children of base men. They were flogged out of the land.
8.asv: They arechildren of fools, yea, children of base men; They were scourged out of the land.

9.web: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.
9.asv: And now I am become their song, Yea, I am a byword unto them.

10.web: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
10.asv: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, And spare not to spit in my face.

11.web: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
11.asv: For he hath loosed his cord, and afflicted me; And they have cast off the bridle before me.

12.web: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.
12.asv: Upon my right hand rise the rabble; They thrust aside my feet, And they cast up against me their ways of destruction.

13.web: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, without anyone’s help.
13.asv: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, Even men that have no helper.

14.web: As through a wide breach they come, in the midst of the ruin they roll themselves in.
14.asv: As through a wide breach they come: In the midst of the ruin they roll themselves upon me.

15.web: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.
15.asv: Terrors are turned upon me; They chase mine honor as the wind; And my welfare is passed away as a cloud.

16.web: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold on me.
16.asv: And now my soul is poured out within me; Days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

17.web: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
17.asv: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, And thepainsthat gnaw me take no rest.

18.web: By great force is my garment disfigured. It binds me about as the collar of my coat.
18.asv: By God’sgreat force is my garment disfigured; It bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

19.web: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.
19.asv: He hath cast me into the mire, And I am become like dust and ashes.

20.web: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.
20.asv: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not answer me: I stand up, and thou gazest at me.

21.web: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.
21.asv: Thou art turned to be cruel to me; With the might of thy hand thou persecutest me.

22.web: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.
22.asv: Thou liftest me up to the wind, thou causest me to rideupon it; And thou dissolvest me in the storm.

23.web: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.
23.asv: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, And to the house appointed for all living.

24.web: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?
24.asv: Howbeit doth not one stretch out the hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

25.web: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?
25.asv: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? Was not my soul grieved for the needy?

26.web: When I looked for good, then evil came; When I waited for light, there came darkness.
26.asv: When I looked for good, then evil came; And when I waited for light, there came darkness.

27.web: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.
27.asv: My heart is troubled, and resteth not; Days of affliction are come upon me.

28.web: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.
28.asv: I go mourning without the sun: I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

29.web: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
29.asv: I am a brother to jackals, And a companion to ostriches.

30.web: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
30.asv: My skin is black, and fallethfrom me, And my bones are burned with heat.

31.web: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.
31.asv: Therefore is my harpturnedto mourning, And my pipe into the voice of them that weep.
